视觉传感器识别颜色，推杆把绿色零件推进旁边的料箱，蓝色零件走到线尾。: The vision sensor identifies the part color. The pusher moves green parts into the adjacent bin, while blue parts continue to the end of the line.
颜色识别 V1 视野内有零件: Color Sensor V1 Part in View
推杆前光电 S1 检测到: Part Detected by Pusher Photo-eye S1
视觉传感器在推杆上游 1.2 m：零件经过视觉时先把颜色记下来（锁存），到推杆前: The vision sensor is 1.2 m upstream of the pusher: latch each part's color as it passes the sensor, then use the stored color when it reaches the pusher.
用 S1 的上升沿（R_TRIG）触发推杆，避免一个零件推两次。: Use the rising edge of S1 (R_TRIG) to trigger the pusher so that each part is pushed only once.
推杆是单电控气缸：P1_EXTEND 保持为 1 才伸出，到位后断开就缩回。: The pusher uses a single-solenoid pneumatic cylinder: P1_EXTEND must stay at 1 to extend it. Once it reaches the extended position, turn the output off to retract it.
按启动让它连续跑几分钟，看分拣对不对（这里显示当前正确率）: Press Start and let it run continuously for a few minutes. Check that sorting is correct (the current accuracy is shown here).
连续运行时不能出现碰撞（这里显示当前次数）: There must be no collisions during continuous operation (the current count is shown here).
连续运行时零件不能被挡住走不动（这里显示当前次数）: Parts must not get blocked and stop moving during continuous operation (the current count is shown here).
连续运行不停线，这里显示当前每分钟产出（刚启动时偏低）: Keep the line running continuously. The current output per minute is shown here (it may be low just after startup).
按一下启动，主输送带（评分看 C1_FWD）开始运行: Press Start once to run the main conveyor (C1_FWD is used for scoring).
急停：立即停止且复位后不自启: E-Stop: stop immediately and do not restart automatically after reset.
运行时点一下急停：0.2 秒内运动输出全部断开；再点一下复位，设备不能自己动: While the equipment is running, press E-Stop once: all motion outputs must turn off within 0.2 s. Press Reset once; the equipment must not start moving by itself.
急停复位后可以重新启动: The conveyor can be restarted after the E-Stop is reset.
急停复位后按启动，C1_FWD 重新运行: After resetting E-Stop, press Start. C1_FWD should run again.
按启动 1 秒后 C1_FWD 还是 0（没有运行）: C1_FWD is still 0 (not running) 1 second after pressing Start
按下急停后运动输出没有立即断开: The motion output does not turn off immediately when E-Stop is pressed
急停复位后设备自己重新启动了（必须再按启动）: The equipment restarts by itself after E-Stop is reset (Start must be pressed again)
急停复位后按启动不能恢复运行: The equipment does not resume operation when Start is pressed after E-Stop is reset
启停自锁：启动并联自锁触点，串常闭停止和急停: Start/Stop latch: connect the Start contact in parallel with the holding contact, in series with the normally closed Stop and E-Stop contacts
视觉识别到绿色：置位\"绿色\"标志: Vision detects green: set the "green" flag
视觉识别到其他颜色：复位标志: Vision detects another color: reset the flag
S1 上升沿 + 绿色：推杆动作: S1 rising edge + green: actuate the pusher
推杆动作后清掉颜色标志: Clear the color flag after the pusher actuates
伸出到位或停机：推杆缩回: Pusher retracts when fully extended or when the line stops
绿色零件不被推出，直接走到线尾: Green parts are not pushed out and continue to the end of the line
推杆不再动作（没有上升沿）: The pusher no longer actuates (no rising edge)
所有零件都不推（颜色码一直为 0）: No parts are pushed out (color code always 0)
推杆不动，P1_FRONT 一直不到位: The pusher does not move, and P1_FRONT never indicates the extended position
推杆变慢，零件被推歪或没推进料箱: The pusher slows down, pushing the part off course or failing to push it into the bin
偶尔多推/漏推: Occasionally pushes too many parts or misses a push
